entries.def:
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω 
to set in order further: Tit.1.5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).† 
(AS)

ἐπι-δύω 
[in LXX: Deu.24.15, Jos.8.29, Jer.15.9 (בּוֹא)* ;] 
to go down, set (of the sun): Eph.4.26.†
(AS)

ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ 
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2.19; 12.18 Bar.2.27, from LXX Bar.4.24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2.22 2Mac.10.4, 3Ma.3.15 3Mac.7.6 * ;] 
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Act.24.4 with πραΰτης, 2Co.10.1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

ἐπιεικής, -ές
(εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Psa.86.5 (סַלָּח), Est.8.13 * ;] 
__1. seemly, fitting (Hom.). 
__2. equitable, fair, moderate: 1Ti.3.3, Tit.3.2, 1Pe.2.18, Jas.3.17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Php.4.5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.with, and see: ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια see: ἐπιεικία
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ 
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2.19; 12.18 Bar.2.27, from LXX Bar.4.24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2.22 2Mac.10.4, 3Ma.3.15…

ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, 4Ki.8.8, Isa.62.12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, 3Ki.20.1, Ecc.7.28), Hos.3.5; פָּקַד, 2Ki.3.8 ;] 
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv), 
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6.32; 12.39; 16.4, Luk.12.30, Act.19.39, Rom.11.7, Php.4.17, Heb.11.14; 13.14; with accusative of person(s), Luk.4.42, Act.12.19; with inf., Act.13.7.†
(AS)

ἐπιθανάτιος, -ον 
[in LXX: From Bel.1.31 ;] 
condemned to death: 1Co.4.9.†
(AS)

ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: 2Ch.25.27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ezk.23.11 (עֲגָבָה) 2Ma.4.41 2Mac.5.5 2Mac.14.15 * ;] 
__1. a laying on: χειρῶν, Act.8.18, 1Ti.4.14, 2Ti.1.6, Heb.6.2 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with). 
__2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†
(AS)

ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;] 
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Jas.4.2, Rom.7.7; 13.9" (LXX), 1Co.10.6 (of. 4Ma.2.6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), Gal.5.17 prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, Act.20.33, 1Ti.3.1; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), Mat.5.28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Exo.20.17, Mic.2.2, Wis.16.3,…

ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Num.11.34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Pro.1.22 (חָמַד)* ;] 
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, 1Co.10.6.†
(AS)

ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;] 
desire, longing: Luk.22.15 (see: ἐπιθυμέω), Php.1.23, 1Th.2.17, Rev.18.14; p1., Mrk.4.19 esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Rom.7.7-8, Jas.1.14-15, 2Pe.1.4; pl., Gal.5.24, 1Ti.6.9, 2Ti.2.22; 4.3, 1Pe.1.14; 4.2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, 1Th.4.5 ἐ. κακή, Col.3.5 with genitive, μιασμοῦ, 2Pe.2.10 (see…
